description: Secured unicast frames, draft 0 (draft/unicast-security.md), and their acknowledgements (draft/forwarding.md). For each accepted case, an implementation given session_secret, direction, counter, hops, power, next, destination and plaintext MUST produce frame, and given session_secret, direction and frame MUST recover counter and plaintext. Each rejected case MUST be rejected by a receiver holding session_secret and expecting counter in direction. For each sequence, a receiver of a new session given the deliveries in order, each at at_s seconds, MUST accept exactly those marked accept, with that counter and plaintext, and MUST acknowledge exactly those marked acknowledge, with the frame's tag and that proof; a delivery marked restart comes after the receiver has restarted, keeping only what it stored. For each collision case, a receiver holding every listed session, all new, given the deliveries in order, each at at_s seconds, MUST accept exactly those marked accept, attributed to that session (an index into sessions) and counter, with that plaintext, and for each delivery MUST send exactly the acknowledgements listed, each with the frame's tag and that proof, to the other end of that session. For each senders case, an implementation acting as both ends of a new session, given each send's direction and plaintext in order and choosing the counter itself, MUST produce that send's frame, or, where frame is null, MUST NOT send in the session but start again; a send marked restart comes after both ends have restarted, keeping only what they stored, and then is what became of the message afterwards: acknowledged (validly), given up, or null for nothing yet. counter is given only to help debugging. For each lifetimes case, a node that derived a session's secret at made_s seconds MAY send in it at at_s if sends is true and MUST NOT if it is false, and MUST have erased it by at_s if holds is false. For each acknowledgements case, the node that sent message counter in direction, holding session_secret, MUST take frame as showing that the message arrived if valid is true, and MUST NOT if it is false. Values are hex; hdr is 72 (0x48), or 73 with the node flag set. hops, power, next and destination are integers, power signed, laid out as draft/forwarding.md gives, and where a case does not give them they are 32, 14, 0x0A0B0C0D and 0x01020304.

accepted.name: first-of-epoch-1
accepted.note: counter 32: epoch 1, one step of the epoch chain, and epoch 1's tag key

accepted.name: relayed
accepted.note: hops, power and next as a relay three hops on left them; not authenticated

accepted.name: for-the-node
accepted.note: the node flag set: the plaintext is a group's invite (draft/groups.md), and the counter is the session's like any other

rejected.name: tag-flipped
rejected.note: last bit of the AEAD tag changed

rejected.name: header-changed
rejected.note: the node flag set on a frame sealed without it: the header is authenticated

rejected.name: first-draft-layout
rejected.note: the tag at offset 4, as this section first had it: 16 bytes

rejected.name: wrong-direction
rejected.note: the responder's counter-0 frame, checked as the initiator's

rejected.name: first-draft-tag-key-0
rejected.note: counter 0 sealed whole, but with the destination tag the first draft's one tag key gives

rejected.name: first-draft-tag-key-32
rejected.note: counter 32 sealed whole, but with the destination tag the first draft's one tag key gives

sequences.name: replay
sequences.note: the same frame twice: the second is a replay

sequences.name: replay-later
sequences.note: a frame replayed after later ones

sequences.name: reordered
sequences.note: arriving out of order, all within the window

sequences.name: first-window
sequences.note: before anything is accepted the window is 0 to 31

sequences.name: ahead-edge
sequences.note: H + 32 is the last counter ahead in the window

sequences.name: ahead-beyond
sequences.note: H + 33 is outside it: 32 lost in a row

sequences.name: behind
sequences.note: after H = 60, counter 28 has left the window and 29 has not

sequences.name: copy-kept
sequences.note: a copy of counter 0 is acknowledged while H is 31 or less

sequences.name: copy-forgotten
sequences.note: and no longer once H is 32

sequences.name: copy-capped
sequences.note: COPY_ACKS acknowledgements of one message, the first among them, and no more

sequences.name: copy-late
sequences.note: a copy is answered COPY_TIME after its message was accepted, and not a second later

sequences.name: copy-forged
sequences.note: frames with counter 1's tag and hdr that are not it, of its length and of another: neither is a copy, and neither is answered

sequences.name: restart
sequences.note: the window outlives a restart: a counter accepted before is not accepted again, and one not yet accepted still is. The replays come after COPY_TIME, so that whether a copy is answered does not depend on what a restart kept

sequences.name: restart-ahead
sequences.note: H outlives a restart: after H = 32, counter 64 is in the window and 65 is not

collisions.name: tag-collision-0
collisions.note: two sessions whose tags collide; the frame is session 0's

collisions.name: tag-collision-1
collisions.note: two sessions whose tags collide; the frame is session 1's

collisions.name: tag-collision-both
collisions.note: both colliding frames to one receiver: the second session's entry must survive the first acceptance. Then a copy of each, which shares its tag with both messages but its AEAD tag with its own: it is acknowledged for its own alone

senders.name: both-directions
senders.note: the two directions count separately from 0

senders.name: into-epoch-1
senders.note: 34 messages from the initiator: counters 0 to 33, across an epoch

senders.name: restarts
senders.note: the counter outlives a restart of both ends: each goes on from the next

senders.name: unanswered
senders.note: 32 messages with nothing acknowledged, and no more: counter 32 might be beyond the receiver's window

senders.name: acknowledged-moves-on
senders.note: with counter 5 acknowledged, messages go up to 37, and no further

senders.name: given-up
senders.note: two messages given up in a row: the third starts again

senders.name: given-up-apart
senders.note: an acknowledgement between two given up: the next goes

senders.name: given-up-restart
senders.note: what is given up outlives a restart

acknowledgements.name: first
acknowledgements.note: the destination's answer to counter 0, initiator to responder

acknowledgements.name: relayed
acknowledgements.note: the same, some hops on: the head is not checked here

acknowledgements.name: epoch-1
acknowledgements.note: counter 32: its tag and proof are made with epoch 1's tag key

acknowledgements.name: reply
acknowledgements.note: the responder's counter 0, answered by the initiator

acknowledgements.name: proof-flipped
acknowledgements.note: last bit of the proof changed

acknowledgements.name: tag-for-proof
acknowledgements.note: the message's tag sent back as its proof: all a node on the way has

acknowledgements.name: another-direction
acknowledgements.note: counter 0's tag with the other direction's proof

acknowledgements.name: another-message
acknowledgements.note: the acknowledgement of counter 1, checked against counter 0

acknowledgements.name: too-long
acknowledgements.note: a byte more than an acknowledgement has

acknowledgements.name: first-draft-tag-key
acknowledgements.note: counter 32's tag and proof as the first draft's one tag key made them
